title: Update all installed packages on Arch Linux
summary: Synchronize the package database and upgrade all installed packages to their latest versions. This is the standard way to keep an Arch Linux system up to date.

steps.explain: Synchronize the package database and upgrade all outdated packages. You will be prompted to confirm the installation.

rollback.explain: There is no simple command to downgrade all packages at once. If an update breaks your system, you may need to manually downgrade specific packages using `pacman -U` with older package files from the cache or mirror.

warnings: Always read the Arch Linux news before updating, especially if you haven't updated in a long time.
Do not interrupt the update process once it has started.
